title: The Watchtower Imperative: Lifespan-Calibrated Evaluation for Frontier AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.35725v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The gap between AI capability deployment and safety assurance is structural and cannot be closed through internal evaluations alone. Analyzing documented harms (2017-2026) across the human lifespan reveals that disparate incidents --- from voice assistants endangering children to AI companions implicated in adolescent suicide and automated care denials for the elderly --- reflect a single failure: evaluating systems against an implicit adult user model. We introduce five developmental moderators structured into a Lifespan Vulnerability Matrix across six life stages. The matrix reveals a nonmonotonic risk distribution: vulnerability peaks at both ends of the lifespan, governance coverage is asymmetrical, and authority to convert model errors into real-world impact is scrutinized least. translated_title: 瞭望塔之必要：面向前沿AI的全生命周期校准评估
translated_abstract: AI能力部署与安全保障之间的差距是结构性的，仅靠内部评估无法弥合。对2017至2026年间记录在案、横跨人类全生命周期的危害事件的分析表明，各类看似孤立的事件——从语音助手危及儿童，到AI陪伴应用与青少年自杀相关联，再到自动化系统拒绝为老年人提供照护——都反映出同一个失败：系统评估始终基于一个隐含的成年用户模型。我们引入五个发展性调节因素，将其组织成覆盖六个生命阶段的“生命周期脆弱性矩阵”。该矩阵揭示了一种非单调的风险分布：脆弱性在生命的两端达到峰值，治理覆盖呈现不对称性，而将模型错误转化为现实影响的最终权力所受到的审查最少。我们进而提出一套从现有儿童保护工具推广而来的全生命周期设计原则，以及一个不依赖任何特定机构的三层外部评估框架……
tldr: 本文通过覆盖六个生命阶段的“生命周期脆弱性矩阵”揭示AI风险在生命两端（儿童与老年人）达到峰值且所受审查最少，并提出全生命周期设计原则和不依赖特定机构的三层外部评估框架，以弥合AI部署与安全保障之间的结构性差距。
en_tdlr: Using a Lifespan Vulnerability Matrix across six life stages, this paper shows that AI risks peak at both ends of the lifespan (children and the elderly) with the least oversight, and proposes lifespan design principles plus an institution-agnostic three-tier external evaluation framework to close the structural gap between AI deployment and safety assurance.
